comments.author: @LifewaysTravel
comments.text: Would you be brave enough to live in Churchill for an entire year, or is that too extreme for you? Let us know in the comments! 🐻‍❄❄ Thanks for watching and exploring this incredible community with us! ❤

comments.author: @Tomato8386
comments.text: What struck me most is that Churchill has no road to the rest of Canada at all — everything and everyone arrives by train or plane, and for a few weeks each autumn the whole town of under 900 people lives around the polar bears moving through. The detail about locals leaving their cars unlocked so anyone can jump in and escape a bear says it all.

comments.author: @travelintolifeus
comments.text: Living in Churchill must require a special kind of courage and patience. The long, bitter winters, remote location, and polar bears roaming nearby make everyday life so different from anything most of us know. I'm amazed by how this community has adapted to such an extraordinary environment.
